decision: The full seven-path patch suppresses CVA writes while required-selection text is being entered and rewrites modern demo/example filtering to use raw input instead of model changes. The untouched16.2.14 ordinary base already has the guard, and the historical legacy directive extends it. The owned legacy base retains that exact guard; its current complete input method emits identical JS to both genuine minimum peer handlers. Eighteen input mode/number/repetition cases run with real borrowed FormControl callbacks on original, owned and each peer; four historical close/choose cases match original and owned. Six targeted corruptions reject. Public owned directive host input binding and its NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR provider are inspected; actual Angular CVA/provider/browser execution remains pending. The modern demos are absent from the add-on package. No product port or changed consumer filter contract is required.
